title: Reef42 Invert Database

data_policy.null_policy: Unknown or not sufficiently supported values are null; do not infer.
data_policy.minimum_tank_size: Approximate conservative hobby guidance, not a scientifically standardized species threshold. Reassess per adult size, swimming behavior, aquascape and husbandry.
data_policy.lifespan: Wild and aquarium lifespan values are intentionally null until species-specific reliable evidence is sourced.
data_policy.ethical_index: Provisional Reef42 editorial score, not a scientific metric. Low-confidence scores are hypotheses for review, not evidence of measured mortality or lifespan. Scores must be supported by species-specific husbandry evidence before public release.
data_policy.photos: No images are stored. Sources link to external references only.
data_policy.taxonomy: Some aquarium-trade names may not map cleanly to a single species; verify identification before publishing.
data_policy.subgroups: Each species has a subgroup.id for filtering and a localized display name for category navigation.
data_policy.images: Each species has image_reference.source_page_url and image_reference.commons_search_url. These are external photo/reference pages, not guaranteed direct image binaries. Verify the license and attribution of each individual file before reuse. direct_image_url is null until a specific licensed asset is selected.
data_policy.hungarian_fish_names: Only names found in Hungarian marine-aquarium trade references or explicitly confirmed by the Reef42 team are populated. If no established name was found, hu_name is null; no literal translation is forced.
data_policy.sources: At least three external cross-check source records are attached to newly added v3 species; older records have at least two source records where practical. Sources are mapped to supported information types; source presence does not mean every field is independently confirmed.
data_policy.pro_tips: The pro_tips key is omitted when no genuinely useful species-specific tip was identified.
data_policy.research_batch_policy: New records are research-stage entries. Where species-level evidence was not available, values remain null or are marked provisional; do not present ethical scores as measured science.

revision_notes: Added taxonomic subgroups to all 50 species.
Added external photo/reference page and Wikimedia Commons image-search link for every species; direct image files remain unset until license is checked.
Removed generic pro_tips; only actionable species-specific tips remain.
Reworked awkward literal Hungarian phrasing in behavioral notes.
Reviewed Hungarian fish names against hobby references; unverified literal translations were removed.
Corrected Fimbriaphyllia ancora and Fimbriaphyllia divisa taxonomy and updated their IDs.
Corrected Trochus niloticus to the currently accepted WoRMS name Rochia nilotica and retained previous ID/name aliases.
Cleaned up mistranslated coral/invert display names; removed misleading Millepora translation and the nonstandard “Pénzes garnéla” label.

Expanded with 35 additional commonly traded marine aquarium species (13 fish, 12 corals, 10 invertebrates); subgroup metadata, external image references and multi-source cross-check links added. New Hungarian names remain null unless verified against established Hungarian hobby usage.

changes: Added 24 common-trade species: 8 fish, 8 corals and 8 invertebrates.
Repaired malformed fish subgroup objects in existing v2 records.
Added additional group metadata for hawkfish, Pectinia, encrusting LPS, sun corals, brittle stars, feather duster worms and conchs.
Added species-level image reference and Commons search link for every newly added species.
Each newly added species has at least three distinct source records, including a taxonomy reference.
Unknown Hungarian hobby names remain null rather than translated literally.
Updated schema enums for moderate_difficult care and NPS corals; converted several generic taxonomy references to species-targeted pages.
quality_notes: Minimum aquarium volumes remain conservative hobby guidance, not standardized scientific thresholds.
Ethical scores are editorial and provisional; evidence confidence is low until collection-origin and captive-survival data are available.
Direct image file URLs remain null until a specific image license and attribution are verified.
